en.title: Managing Seller Balances and Payout Withdrawals
en.excerpt: Understanding available vs pending seller balances, requesting bank payouts, and tracking transaction settlement ledgers.
en.content:
Available vs Pending Balance

Under Seller Dashboard > Finance > Balance, your funds are divided into:

  • Pending Balance: Funds from in-transit orders currently held safely in buyer protection escrow.
  • Available Balance: Cleared funds from completed orders ready for immediate withdrawal to your bank account.

Requesting a Bank Withdrawal

To withdraw funds, click Request Withdrawal, select your verified bank account, and enter the withdrawal amount. The minimum withdrawal threshold is Rp 50,000.

Disbursement Timelines & Fees

Standard bank payouts are processed within 1 business day via automated clearing networks. Detailed disbursement history logs and downloadable transaction statements are available in the finance tab.
